## Notes

- Write path: the relay (`post-stamped.mjs`, `label-write.mjs`, `fleet-write/dispatch.mjs`); ⛔ GitHub MCP writes.
- Platform facts measured this shift: a cloud seat cannot push `mailbox/<login>` through the fleet gate (`mailbox-open.mjs` needs `--head` of a branch the session pushed); the relay's `issue_patch` refuses a body without the seat signature as its first line, so a seat cannot refresh a dev-written PR body without displacing its `Fixes #n` first line (the seat record on the PR carries corrected readings instead).
- Mailbox PR #27296 closed at sign-off; the successor opens its own.
